notes: Building-level decomposition of fairlend-toronto-cityscape.webp. All crops produced from this spec are reference-only inputs for later standalone generated assets; do not ship, optimize, or treat these crops as final production images. The source uses overlapping isometric perspective, so bboxes capture each visible structure plus its roof cap and immediate shadow where practical.
